correctness.rationale: Rigorous two-sided isomorphism-orbit squeeze: union-bound fraction of non-2LI matrices, known and reproved 2LI monomial uniqueness, explicit Burnside sum over all monomial elements, and exact rank formula. Fixed permutation contributes at most q^{-sn/2} per element; diagonal scalings contribute O_q(n q^{-n}); together R=O_q(n^2(1-1/q)^n). These estimates are independent of corank. Finite exact checks confirm the monomial-versus-genuine class distinction. No finite experiment is used in place of the asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 survey labels the all-algebra asymptotic open. The 2023 perfect Burnside enumeration and 2020/2025 2LI rigidity results do not count singular true isomorphism classes. The new uniform positive-corank orbit squeeze provides asymptotic constants and a nonperfect limiting fraction. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently phrased result may already establish all-corank isomorphism enumeration.
Perfect-corank asymptotic alone is covered by prior perfect-only results; novelty is in singular strata and the full census.
